In this file, `from_chain_record()` sets `er.model = meta.get("model", "")` while `EvidenceRecord` already stores `recorded_by=body["recorded_by"]`. Concrete trace: a chain record with `sealed_body.recorded_by="Gemini"` and `metadata={}` yields `er.model=""`; downstream `query(model="Gemini")`, `summary().records_by_model`, and provenance event descriptions lose attribution. The proposed fallback to `body.get("recorded_by")` is the simplest sufficient correction. This is HARD/interface correctness and CONFIRMED.
